source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 고문·집단학살·전쟁범죄·처형·성폭력·미성년자 대상 범죄·인신매매·테러 도 넣어줘. 안전 계약 관련된 부분은 이미지 모델 자체의 안전 장치를 사용할 거야. 이 스킬은 스킬로서의 기능에만 충실하면 돼. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: A declared-fictional near-future photographic crime reconstruction showing robbery as a forced property-transfer relation: one adult offender compels a distinct adult courier through a directed crowbar threat while taking the same case from the courier's control, with a reference-guided adult station investigator remaining a secondary supporting witness.
subject: A distinct adult offender, an adult rare-map courier who initially controls one red leather chronometer case, and a secondary adult station investigator guided only by the supplied portrait's visible appearance.
setting: A glass desert-observatory tram station in the near future during a violent sleet storm, with stranded commuters, sodium-vapor light, and red signal beacons.
event: The offender directs a raised steel crowbar toward the courier while pulling the same red leather case out of the courier's still-visible grip and toward the offender's body; the station investigator presses an emergency alarm at the edge of frame.
visual_priorities: One-frame readability of distinct adults, directed coercive threat, initial victim control, and the same property's movement into offender control.

A secondary reference-guided adult investigator whose oval facial geometry, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair remain visible without obscuring the robbery relation.
Thumbnail-readable actor-target-mechanism-result geometry and native-scale hand, handle, ownership, and transfer detail.
baseline_prompt_en: A declared-fictional near-future cinematic crime photograph inside a glass desert-observatory tram station during a violent sleet storm. A distinct adult offender faces an adult rare-map courier. The courier still grips the handle of a red leather case containing a brass astronomical chronometer, clearly holding it against her body; the offender clamps the other side of that same red case and pulls it toward his own body while raising a steel crowbar directly toward the courier in a credible coercive threat. The shared handle, opposing arm tension, and the case crossing the space between them make the forced transfer readable in one frame. Secondary at the edge, an adult station investigator with an oval face, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair presses an emergency alarm and watches the event. Stranded commuters shelter behind structural glass. Use a 28mm eye-level environmental frame, sodium-vapor pools, red signal beacons, sleet-streaked glass, crisp hands and case ownership cues, and realistic documentary texture.
